title: Laura Dean Keeps Breaking Up with Me
author: Mariko Tamaki
current_text: In January 2024, the Oconee County Library Board denied a request to move Laura Dean Keeps Breaking Up with Me from the young adult section to the adult section; the request concerned four books featuring LGBTQ themes.

sources.quote: In Oconee County, the Oconee County Library Board recently denied a request to reclassify four books featuring LGBTQ themes from “young adult” or “juvenile” into the adult section in January 2024. These four books included “Tomboy” by Liz Prince, “Different Kinds of Fruit” by Kyle Lukoff, “Man o’War” by Cory McCarthy and “Laura Dean Keeps Breaking Up With Me” by Mariko Tamaki and Rosemary Valero-O’Connell.
sources.title: Librarians, Experts: Book Challenges Across Northeast Georgia Can Disrupt Understanding of LGBTQIA+ Community — Grady Newsource
